scope: Full static review of six Studio approval, delivery, publication and evidence panels plus handoff and maintenance validation helpers; not full frontend or real workflow acceptance
review_notes: CandidateApproval is keyed by candidate identity in App; validation, design approval and sealing remain separate; uncertain actions require saved review recovery.
Publication report requires PASS plus remote_verified; archive and retrieval results remain independently visible.
Delivery list and inspection use request generations to reject stale responses.
Evidence retention validates identity and size, requires confirmation, and disables repeat after uncertain outcome; external persistence remains separate.
Handoff preview validates plan identity, target, complete asset hashes and absence of remote writes; approval and export require explicit review and uncertain outcomes require reloading.
Evidence persistence uses configured backend identity, confirms independent readback, and blocks automatic retries after completion or uncertainty.

verification.command: npm test -- src/CandidateApproval.test.tsx src/PublicationHistory.test.tsx src/deliveryStatus.test.ts src/historyRequest.test.ts
